The Industry Performance page ranks sectors of stocks by Price Change (the difference in the last price and the previous, settlement price) over selected periods of time. This page is designed to show you the best performing sectors of the market over the selected period of time. Use the checkbox at the top of the page to include all sectors, including those with less than 10 stocks. The list of symbols included on the page is **updated every 10 minutes throughout the trading day**. Most data tables can be analyzed using "Views." A View simply presents the symbols on the page with a different set of columns. Click the "+" icon in the first column (on the left) to view more data for the selected symbol. The "More Data" widgets are also available from the Links column of the right side of the data table. Also unique to Barchart, Flipcharts allow you to scroll through all the symbols on the table in a chart view.
